criteria.requirement: Implement tabulate.pages.iter_pages(rows,page_size,headers=(),*,showindex=False,**options). Lazily read one-shot rows, count data rows excluding separators, render each page with the pinned tabulate and repeat explicit headers or consume firstrow headers once. Automatic indices are global zero-based business indices across pages; separators retain order and boundary separators belong to the next page. Never prefetch the next data row before yielding a full page; emit no empty final page. Validate positive integer size and supported automatic-index/header options; leave arbitrary custom index streams out of this API.
Deliver the authorized source changes, public regression tests that fail on the original version, and English compatibility documentation. All frozen native regression tests must pass.

comparison: Accept equivalent implementations according to actual program behavior; do not grade by matching reference text or its length.
